title: Pattanathil Sundaran
desc: Sundaresan, a grocery store owner, marries an educated girl who gets a good job in another city soon after the wedding. Though he follows her to the new city, he plots so that she resigns.

title: Kaashmora
desc: Kaashmora, a fraudster, gets locked inside a haunted bungalow, along with his clan. Soon, the family faces an army of ghosts who will let them leave only if their wishes are granted.

title: Alangu
desc: While trying to cross over to Kerala, a Tamil tribal boy and his group of friends get drawn into communal clashes that erupt along the state border.

title: The Door
desc: Mithra, an architect, demolishes an old site to construct a new building. However, her actions end up releasing a paranormal entity into her life.

title: Ushiran
desc: Murugavel, a police officer, learns that his younger brother is a petty criminal working for a local gangster. When he tries to bring about a positive change in him, the brother tries to kill him.

title: Shyam Singha Roy
desc: A director accused of plagiarism finds a transcendental connection to his past life when he digs deeper into his subconscious mind.
